title: Local sessions stop failing on the GitHub plugin's empty token
why: A mailaudit session's finding, Oct 26: the GitHub plugin sends 'Bearer ${GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN}' with the variable unset, so GitHub's MCP server refuses it on every local session.
note: Ruling, Oct 27 12:07 CDT (shiv, waiting page item 35): (b), try a token once on the Mac and see what it adds before choosing. Next: you make a read-only GitHub token and paste it yourself (Claude never types a token); a Mac session started by the local liaison sets it for that one session, shows you what the plugin adds next to what the app already shows, then you pick (a) turn the plugin off, or keep it with the token; the token is deleted if you pick (a). Waits on: a local session. Checked claude-settings main 54be9f1: its enabledPlugins does not list a GitHub plugin, so it is switched on outside the managed settings; where is unknown until a local session looks. The fix lands in claude-settings so every machine gets it. Port: no; global settings install everywhere. Placed ahead of c54, after c47 (triage, Oct 26): both are local setup on your machines.
